subject.title: fix: keep inbound metadata in runtime context

question: Should the inbound-metadata fix land as this focused before-user runtime-context handoff, be folded into PR 100272, or be replaced by PR 100272's tail-carrier implementation?
rationale: Both branches preserve current-turn metadata outside user-authored prompt text, but PR 100272 adds cache-placement and provider-anchor behavior; automation should not choose that permanent prompt/session contract alone.

options.title: Use PR 100272 As Canonical
options.body: Make the tail-carrier branch the canonical implementation if maintainers accept its broader provider/cache contract, and close or credit this PR after that path is settled.

options.title: Refresh This Focused Branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the smaller landing path, rebase it across the current runtime-context helper changes, and track tail/cache placement as separate follow-up work.

options.title: Hold Both Until Prompt Contract Review
options.body: Keep both PRs open while maintainers review the model-visible prompt layout and channel-context compatibility trade-off.

recommendation.title: Use PR 100272 As Canonical
recommendation.body: Make the tail-carrier branch the canonical implementation if maintainers accept its broader provider/cache contract, and close or credit this PR after that path is settled.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman has recent merged history around the LLM-boundary prompt/timestamp behavior and is a good routing owner for the prompt-layout compatibility choice.
